mechanism_narrative: A higher-than-average federal funds rate compresses equity valuations by increasing the discount rate for future cash flows, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is above 5.0% (the 90th percentile of the historical distribution).

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year CPI inflation rate exceeds 4.0%, the Federal Reserve is likely to maintain a restrictive monetary policy, causing S&P 500 forward returns to decline over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL yoy inflation exceeds 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production and housing starts signals a weakening in the real economy, which triggers a sell-off in equities as investors anticipate reduced corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in INDPRO and HOUST fails to predict negative returns: the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a low-unemployment regime (UNRATE < 3.5%), a decline in payroll employment signals an imminent economic slowdown, causing S&P 500 forward returns to turn negative over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE < 3.5% and PAYEMS declines by more than 0.5% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below its 12-month moving average indicates a weakening manufacturing sector, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is below its 12-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: In a high consumer spending regime (RSAFS above 90th percentile), a decline in residential construction (HOUST) signals a cooling in the housing market, causing S&P 500 forward returns to turn negative over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS is above the 90th percentile and HOUST declines by more than 1.0% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained expansion in real GDP (GDPC1) above its 4-quarter moving average signals strong economic growth, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 is above its 4-quarter moving average.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the year-over-year CPI inflation rate below 2.5% signals an easing monetary policy environment, which boosts equity valuations and leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL yoy inflation is below 2.5%.
